efe7d2f7351d22d406e3117d510c62b8f556ed34.summary: A Medium blog post by Wade Hickey, published 2022-03-05, describing how the author recovered the password of a leaked Conti ransomware source code archive. One leaked archive was posted without a password, and known plaintext from it was used with the bkcrack tool to crack the password-protected one. The post names the Conti ransomware group and lists three archive file names, but gives no sector, country, or attribution detail.

efcbb14f8ef15621c8601482e2b24e394aa0cf33.summary: ASEC (AhnLab) analyses 2023 attacks it links to the Andariel group, which the report says is affiliated with Lazarus. Targets include Korean universities, national defense and other companies. Initial access used Innorix Agent abuse and likely spear phishing. Malware includes Go-based backdoors such as Goat RAT and DurianBeacon, plus AndarLoader. The report says the initial distribution route is unconfirmed and that the link to past Andariel cases is inferred, not direct.

ef5b9c628f61fa1a41171eb56e4069d9f450e0ca.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence describes Silk Typhoon, an espionage-focused Chinese state actor, shifting to IT supply chain targets such as remote management tools, cloud applications and managed service providers. It reports stolen API keys used to reach downstream customer tenants, password spray with leaked credentials, zero-day exploitation of edge devices and Exchange servers, abuse of service principals and OAuth applications to exfiltrate email and files, and covert networks of compromised devices. Victims were largely in state and local government and the IT sector. The report…
